facts.label: Where
facts.value: today's place name 厢白旗小营 (osm node 13239886785), C; disagrees with the text

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 日下 j99:29a '其東有鑲白旗護軍小營房' = EAST of the large camp; today's 厢白旗小营 lies 930 m SOUTH of 厢白旗, outside 长春园's east wall. Malone's sketch map (S02 p.54, 'SMALL WHITE BANNER') draws it SOUTH of the Bordered White camp, beside the railway, as today's name does: so the text's 東 is loose or the camp moved; position kept on today's name. Possibly the 1747 extension (S1237): lead.
